name: eight-months-of-silence-agent-workflow
description: Strict, tool-agnostic state machine that any AI coding agent MUST execute for every task in this repository. Enforced in spirit by AGENTS.md and in constraint form by agent/rules.json.
global_rules: No phase may be skipped. No two phases may be silently merged.
Every phase's exit_criteria must be satisfied and stated explicitly before the next phase begins.
If any check in agent/rules.json fails at any point, the agent must stop, fix or report, before proceeding.
An agent may not mark a task DONE. Only HANDOFF is reachable by an agent; DONE is set by a human.

phases.purpose: Understand the literal task request and locate it in the codebase and GDD.
entry_criteria: required_reading has been read this session
actions: Restate the task in one sentence.
Identify which GDD system(s) (docs/GDD.md §7 table) this task touches.
Identify which architecture layer(s) (docs/ARCHITECTURE.md §4) this task touches.
Search the existing codebase for related/overlapping implementations before writing anything new.
exit_criteria: Task restated in agent's own words.
Affected GDD system(s) and layer(s) named explicitly.
Existing related code identified or explicitly confirmed absent.

phases.purpose: Resolve ambiguity or missing information before design work begins.
phases.trigger: Any condition in AGENTS.md §8, OR GDD/architecture/code disagree, OR task scope is underspecified.
actions: State the specific ambiguity or missing fact.
State the default assumption the agent would use if forced to proceed, and why.
If the ambiguity is low-stakes and reversible, state the assumption and proceed to PLAN.
If the ambiguity is high-stakes per AGENTS.md §8 (save schema, final-encounter state machine, layer-boundary change), stop and ask a human; do not proceed to PLAN.
exit_criteria: Either a human answer was received, or a stated, low-risk default assumption was adopted and flagged.

phases.purpose: Design the solution before touching code.
actions: List the concrete files/classes to be added or changed, grouped by layer (Domain / Application / Infrastructure / Presentation).
State the dependency direction of any new relationship and confirm it matches docs/ARCHITECTURE.md §1.
State what tests will be added and at what layer (EditMode/PlayMode).
Identify any new ScriptableObject config data needed instead of hardcoded values.
Identify performance-sensitive code paths (per-frame, per-instantiate) and the mitigation (pooling, avoiding allocation).
exit_criteria: A concrete, layer-annotated file/class plan exists.
No planned change violates a forbidden pattern in docs/CODING_STANDARDS.md §4.

phases.purpose: Self-review the plan against the architecture contract before writing code, catching violations while they're cheap to fix.
actions: Check the plan against every rule in agent/rules.json.
Check the plan against docs/ARCHITECTURE.md §4 system-to-layer mapping.
If the plan requires crossing a layer boundary in a new way, treat as CLARIFY trigger (see AGENTS.md §8) before continuing.
exit_criteria: Plan passes all machine-checkable rules in agent/rules.json.
Plan passes manual review against docs/ARCHITECTURE.md.

phases.purpose: Write the code per the approved plan.
actions: Implement in layer order Domain -> Application -> Infrastructure -> Presentation where dependencies require it.
Follow docs/CODING_STANDARDS.md naming and pattern rules exactly.
Do not introduce any change outside the PLAN's file/class list without returning to PLAN first.
Write tests alongside implementation, not deferred to a later phase.
exit_criteria: All planned files/classes exist and match the PLAN's layer assignment.
Tests planned in PLAN are present.

phases.purpose: Adversarial self-check before claiming success — the agent reviews its own diff as if it were a strict senior reviewer.
actions: Re-read the full diff, not just a summary.
Check every item in docs/DEFINITION_OF_DONE.md applicable to this task type.
Explicitly search the diff for each forbidden pattern in docs/CODING_STANDARDS.md §4.
Confirm no unrelated files were modified.
Confirm no TODO/placeholder logic was left without a docs/DECISIONS.md entry.
exit_criteria: Definition of Done checklist completed and reported.
Any deviation explicitly justified in writing, not silently present.

phases.purpose: Execute and verify automated tests; verify manually where automated testing isn't feasible.
actions: Run EditMode tests for all touched Domain/Application code.
Run PlayMode tests for touched Presentation flows where they exist.
For untestable Presentation/feel changes, state the manual verification steps taken or required.
exit_criteria: All existing tests still pass (no regressions).
New tests required by PLAN exist and pass.
Any skipped/impossible test is explicitly named with a reason.

actions: Update docs/DECISIONS.md if any architectural choice, deferral, or accepted tech debt occurred.
Update docs/ARCHITECTURE.md §4 mapping table if a new system/subsystem was introduced.
Update code comments/XML doc summaries for any new public API surface.
exit_criteria: No architecturally-relevant decision exists only in the agent's chat response and nowhere in the repo.

phases.purpose: Deliver a complete, human-reviewable report. This is the terminal state an agent may reach.
actions: Produce the report format required by AGENTS.md §9: what/why, architecture impact, risks, DoD checklist, follow-ups.
Explicitly flag anything that needed a human decision but proceeded on a stated assumption (from CLARIFY).
exit_criteria: Task status is HANDOFF, not DONE — a human marks DONE after review.

trigger_conditions: GDD, architecture doc, and code disagree
Task requires a new layer-boundary crossing
Task touches the Adrian encounter / final-level state machine
Per-frame hot path with unclear performance budget
Deleting or substantially rewriting code the agent did not author this session without explicit instruction
escalation.action: Stop at current phase, do not proceed, present the issue and a recommended default to a human, resume only after response or an explicitly accepted low-risk default.
